clauses.quote: If you have prepaid fees directly to Spotify for a Paid Subscription that Spotify permanently discontinues prior to the end of your Prepaid Period, Spotify will refund you the prorated portion of the prepaid fees for the Pre-Paid Period after such discontinuation.
